```{r setup}
library(targets)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)

# Load objects from targets store
tar_load(c(sample_meta, counts_filtered, vst_matrix,
           res_interaction, final_clusters))
```

## 1. Sanity Check: Count Distribution

```{r count-distribution}
# Histogram of library sizes
lib_sizes <- colSums(counts_filtered$counts)

data.frame(
  sample_id  = names(lib_sizes),
  lib_size   = lib_sizes
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    tibble::rownames_to_column(sample_meta, "sample_id"),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample_id, lib_size), y = lib_size / 1e6,
             fill = condition)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(lib_sizes)/1e6, linetype="dashed",
             colour="grey40") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(activated="#E64B35", control="#4DBBD5")) +
  labs(title = "Library Sizes",
       x = NULL, y = "Sequencing Depth (M reads)") +
  theme_classic(12)
```

## 2. Quick Dispersion Plot

```{r dispersion}
# Load base dds
tar_load(dds_base)
DESeq2::plotDispEsts(dds_base,
                     main = "DESeq2 Dispersion Estimates — Base Model")
```

## 3. Examine Individual Genes of Interest

```{r gene-plots}
# Candidate genes from T-cell biology literature
candidate_genes <- c("IL2", "IFNG", "TNF", "CD69", "MKI67",
                     "FOXO1", "SLC2A1", "LDHA", "CDK1", "SELL")

vst_long <- vst_matrix[
  intersect(candidate_genes, rownames(vst_matrix)), ,
  drop = FALSE
] |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "vst") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    tibble::rownames_to_column(sample_meta, "sample_id"),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

ggplot(vst_long, aes(x = time_hours, y = vst,
                     colour = condition, group = interaction(condition, donor))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(activated="#E64B35", control="#4DBBD5")) +
  facet_wrap(~gene_id, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  labs(title = "Canonical T-cell Activation Markers",
       x = "Time (h)", y = "VST Expression") +
  theme_classic(10) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face="bold"))
```

## 4. Interaction LRT p-value Distribution

```{r pval-hist}
# Should show enrichment near 0 if there are true signal genes
hist(res_interaction$pvalue,
     breaks = 60,
     col    = "#4DBBD5",
     border = "white",
     main   = "LRT p-value Distribution (Interaction Model)",
     xlab   = "p-value",
     ylab   = "Frequency")
abline(h = nrow(res_interaction) / 60, col = "red", lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = "Expected uniform (null)", col="red",
       lty=2, bty="n")
```

## 5. Mfuzz Membership Score Distribution

```{r membership}
tar_load(cluster_mfuzz)

# Distribution of maximum membership scores (confidence of cluster assignment)
max_mem <- apply(cluster_mfuzz$membership, 1, max)

hist(max_mem, breaks = 40,
     col    = "#F77F00",
     border = "white",
     main   = "Mfuzz — Max Membership Score Distribution",
     xlab   = "Max membership (confidence of assignment)",
     ylab   = "Gene count")
abline(v = 0.5, col = "red", lty = 2)
mtext(paste0("n genes with max > 0.5: ", sum(max_mem > 0.5)), side=3, cex=0.9)
```

## 6. Quick GSEA on Top Interaction DEGs

```{r quick-gsea}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

top_genes_symbol <- res_interaction |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.01) |>
  dplyr::arrange(padj) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 200) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene_id)

entrez_ids <- tryCatch(
  AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = top_genes_symbol,
                        keytype = "SYMBOL", column = "ENTREZID",
                        multiVals = "first"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(entrez_ids)) {
  entrez_clean <- entrez_ids[!is.na(entrez_ids)]
  ego_quick <- enrichGO(gene          = entrez_clean,
                        OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        ont           = "BP",
                        pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                        readable      = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(ego_quick) && nrow(ego_quick@result) > 0) {
    barplot(ego_quick, showCategory = 15,
            title = "Top GO:BP — All Interaction DEGs (FDR<0.01)")
  }
}
```
